findings.current: “He’s more than safe. He’s doing great. Look at me. Can’t you feel this power?”
findings.defect: The Blood Lord answers a question about Jin Taekyung by talking about himself, not by saying Jin is doing great.
findings.rationale: His invitation to look at him and feel his power makes the shift of subject the point of the reply.
findings.replacement: “Safe? I’m better than fine. Look at me. Can’t you feel this power?”
findings.source: 무사하다 못해 훌륭하지. 날 봐, 이 힘이 느껴지지 않나?

findings.current: He instinctively used all his strength to wrench his wrist out of my grasp, but the scorching heat that shot out ahead of him wrapped around him first.
findings.defect: “Ahead of him” makes the heat’s lead sound spatial rather than a matter of timing.
findings.rationale: 그보다 한발 앞서 means the heat reaches him before he can free his wrist.
findings.replacement: He instinctively tried to wrench his wrist out of my grasp with all his strength, but before he could, a surge of scorching heat reached out and engulfed him.
findings.source: 본능적으로 온 힘을 다해 내게 잡힌 손목을 빼내려 하지만, 그보다 한발 앞서 뻗어 나온 뜨거운 열기가 놈을 휘감았다.

findings.defect: “Grandpa” gives Taekyung the familial address Cheongpung uses for Jeok Cheongang, rather than Taekyung’s respectful address.
findings.rationale: 노야 addresses an elder respectfully; it does not establish a grandfather relationship.

findings.defect: The command loses the repeated plea and polite request.
findings.rationale: The source repeats 길을 and ends with the polite request 주십시오.
findings.replacement: “A path. Please open a path for me.”

findings.current: A blind swing of a sword grazed my shoulder.
findings.defect: “Blind swing” describes how someone swung; the source describes a stray blade amid the fighting.
findings.rationale: 눈먼 칼 identifies an indiscriminate or stray strike, without establishing the swordsman’s manner of swinging.
findings.replacement: A stray blade grazed my shoulder.

summary: One subject reversal obscures the Blood Lord’s taunt; several smaller issues affect timing, address, and phrasing.
